baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening 'ألم تر', the doubled ع ل م forms, the heaven-earth span, and 'بكل شيء'.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alerting question recruits the reader's own recognition, then frames divine knowledge as complete disclosure. The heaven-earth merism closes the spatial domain while 'every thing' closes the domain of knowable objects.

activation_trace.role: The alerting and inquiry use makes seeing a demand for cognitive recognition, not merely eyesight.
Disclosure to the knower anchors both the opening claim and closing attribute as one epistemic enclosure.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the verse's spatial totality.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the complementary pole, leaving no vertical outside.
The image of total inclusion gathers all parts into the closing scope claim.
The general knowable and reportable entity makes the closure object-complete rather than merely geographic.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that God knows hidden gatherings.
changed_reading.after: The verse demands recognition that neither a spatial region nor any knowable item can remain outside divine disclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 'نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم' through 'ولا أدنى من ذلك ولا أكثر إلا هو معهم أين ما كانوا'.
baseline_models.mechanism: Secret counsel creates an insider circle, and the numbered examples give that circle a finite boundary. The repeated fourth and sixth reopen each human count; fewer, more, and wherever then remove numerical and spatial exceptions without reducing the divine presence to another human speaker.

activation_trace.role: Secret, restricted exchange supplies the attempted insider boundary that the numerical sequence reopens.
The literal count of three establishes the first apparently closed human set.
Becoming fourth interrupts the closure of the first counted set with divine accompaniment.
The literal count of five varies the group size so the first example cannot remain exceptional.
The sixth repeats the count-opening operation and makes it a rule rather than a one-off image.
The nearer, smaller, or lower comparative removes any lower numerical threshold.
Growth in number removes the upper threshold and scales the mechanism beyond the examples.

changed_reading.before: Three and five are examples of a few groups God happens to know.
changed_reading.after: Every attempted insider circle is arithmetically reopened by an unexcluded divine accompaniment, at every size and location.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two ك و ن forms, 'ثم ينبئهم بما عملوا', and 'يوم القيامة'.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two forms of being locate people and acts in ongoing situations; 'then' carries present accompaniment forward into a later report. News delivered to the actors concerns their intentional deeds when resurrection makes the temporal trajectory public.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time bind both the existence of each counsel and wherever its members were.
A consequential report turns already-known conduct into later addressed disclosure.
Intentional action identifies what the later disclosure concerns, rather than treating presence as static observation.
Resurrection and the standing of creation provide the endpoint at which concealed action is disclosed.

changed_reading.before: Divine presence is a static statement of observation.
changed_reading.after: Accompaniment is an evidence trajectory: situated action remains present to knowledge and returns as a personally addressed report at resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated hearing narrows cosmic omniscience to one complainant and a two-person exchange. Complaint becomes audible disclosure and dialogue becomes reciprocating speech, so the focus ayah's accompaniment includes attention to speech that may be socially small but is not epistemically marginal.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower is the focus anchor revised from abstract scope into attended speech.
Repeated auditory perception makes divine knowledge concrete as hearing an actual voice and exchange.
An expressed complaint supplies the vulnerable speech whose apparent smallness tests the scope of attention.
Back-and-forth speech turns hearing from a detached datum into attendance to a relational exchange.

structural_cues: 58:1 moves from one woman's speech to complaint, two-party dialogue, and threefold divine hearing before 58:7 universalizes knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a heard complaint and reciprocating dialogue; I map that auditory attention onto 58:7's knowledge and accompaniment. A live alternative is that 58:1 merely parallels the attribute of knowledge without implying responsive attention.

changed_reading.before: Universal knowledge can sound like abstract surveillance from cosmic distance.
changed_reading.after: The same universal scope includes hearing an individual complainant inside an intimate exchange; the smallest dialogue is already within divine attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection gathers dispersed actors, exhaustive enumeration retains their deeds, human forgetting fails to erase them, and witnessing supplies presence plus evidentiary disclosure. The focus ayah's future report therefore functions as counter-memory rather than newly acquired information.

activation_trace.role: The consequential report is the focus event sharpened into release of an already retained record.
Intentional deeds provide the record's morally attributable content.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the public convergence in which the retained record returns to its actors.
Counting with exhaustive coverage supplies the retention mechanism behind the later report.
Loss from human memory creates the asymmetry that divine enumeration overcomes.
Presence with direct witnessing makes the record evidentiary rather than a detached inventory.

structural_cues: 58:6 already collocates resurrection, gathering, informing, deeds, exhaustive counting, forgetting, and witnessing; 58:7 repeats the informing-deeds-resurrection chain after explaining omnipresence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit contrast between divine enumeration and human forgetting, followed by witness; I treat 58:7's report as disclosure of that retained counter-memory. The alternative is immediate cognition with no ledger-like retention mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God will tell people what they did because he observed it.
changed_reading.after: The report restores an exhaustively retained past against the actors' own forgetting, with presence functioning as witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secret exchange can be engineered as rebellious distance and aimed at roughening another's inner state, yet its capacity to diminish or injure is explicitly bounded. Divine accompaniment exposes the speakers and, by inference, prevents their counsel from becoming an absolutely sealed world around its targets.

activation_trace.role: Private exchange anchors the focus mechanism whose social effect the later context specifies.
The repeated secret-counsel sense identifies the same focus construction as the vehicle of attempted harm.
Rebellious agency supplies the counsel's hostile direction rather than making privacy intrinsically evil.
Inner roughness through grief identifies the intended affective output of the secret coordination.
Diminution opposed to benefit supplies the bounded causal harm that the verse denies independent force.

structural_cues: 58:8-10 moves from prohibited counsel, through its ethical redirection, to its aim of producing grief and the explicit limitation of harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secret counsel as the source of intended grief and says its harm is limited; I extend 58:7's accompaniment from exposure of the speakers to anti-isolation for the target. A live alternative confines 'معهم' grammatically to the whisperers and leaves protection to 58:10 alone.

changed_reading.before: The fourth or sixth presence only defeats the speakers' secrecy.
changed_reading.after: It also suggests that hostile counsel cannot construct an absolute social enclosure around its targets; its grief-making power remains bounded.

context_deltas.mechanism: An advance gift places a public cost at the threshold of privileged private access. Charity transfers benefit outward, purification describes the resulting ethical change, and anxious reluctance reveals how cost tests the counsel's urgency; privacy can thus be reconfigured before it begins.

activation_trace.role: Private exchange is the focus object revised from a merely observed event into an ethically conditioned access practice.
Advancing something before the counsel creates a temporal and ethical threshold ahead of private access.
A charitable material right makes the threshold benefit someone beyond the private exchange.
Cleansing action from what is base supplies the stated transformation of access through prior giving.
Concern mixed with fear exposes reluctance at the cost threshold and tests whether the counsel is worth initiating.

structural_cues: 58:12 places charity 'before' private consultation and calls it purer; 58:13 immediately names reluctance to advance that charity and then relaxes the requirement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance charity, purification, and reluctance; I infer that cost disciplines asymmetric or privileged access to counsel. The alternative is a test of obedience with no broader access mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Every private counsel is simply another event within exhaustive knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Privileged counsel can be ethically redesigned before it occurs: advance giving makes private access bear an outward-facing cost and tests its urgency.

context_deltas.mechanism: False oaths are repeatedly performed as a protective covering, including after collective resurrection. The focus ayah's trajectory from present accompaniment to later report therefore defeats a self-authored evidentiary shield: speech may manage a human audience but cannot rewrite witnessed action.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reporting anchors the disclosure that ultimately answers the attempted cover.
The oath is the formal speech act used to manufacture credibility.
Contradiction of truth supplies the gap between performed evidence and known reality.
A protective shield makes explicit the oath's intended social function as defensive cover.
Repeating the oath after resurrection shows the defensive performance persisting into the disclosure scene.
The final naming of falsehood collapses the evidentiary cover despite its repetition.

structural_cues: 58:14 joins oath, falsehood, and the actors' own knowledge; 58:16 calls oaths a shield; 58:18 repeats oath-making in the resurrection scene anticipated by 58:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false oaths, their shield function, and their resurrection replay; I treat the shield as social and evidentiary cover pierced by the focus report. It may denote practical protection from people more narrowly, but that still cannot survive the later disclosure.

changed_reading.before: God later reports deeds that happened in secret.
changed_reading.after: The report specifically defeats self-authored evidence: repeated oaths can shield socially, but they cannot alter the action preserved by divine presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast distinguishes modes of relation. Hostile domination collects people into one party, while approved affiliation is marked separately by inscription in hearts and strengthening with spirit. The focus ayah's universal accompaniment therefore guarantees exposure, not equal endorsement or intimacy.

activation_trace.role: Universal disclosure anchors accompaniment as epistemic presence before the context differentiates affiliation.
Domination, possession, and collection supply a rival mode of nearness that captures rather than approves.
A group organized around one position makes affiliation explicit rather than leaving it implicit in mere co-presence.
Binding inscription establishes approved relation internally and durably, beyond universal observation.
The heart locates that inscription in the person's inner center rather than in external group proximity alone.
Supporting strength supplies an active, favorable relation distinct from simple exposure.
Life-giving spirit specifies the medium of special strengthening and keeps it distinct from universal accompaniment.
The opposed party label completes the contrast between observed grouping and chosen affiliation.

structural_cues: 58:19 and 58:22 form opposed party labels, but only the latter adds heart-inscription and strengthening by spirit after 58:7 has said God is with every group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal accompaniment, hostile capture, opposed parties, heart-inscription, and special support; I distinguish epistemic presence from approving affiliation. An alternative reads 'معهم' as already restricted to knowledge, making this a clarification rather than a revision.

changed_reading.before: Being with every group could suggest one undifferentiated kind of proximity for all.
changed_reading.after: Universal accompaniment guarantees exposure, while favorable affiliation is separately marked by inner inscription and strengthening; presence is not endorsement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch of ن ج و as raised ground beyond flood rather than the noun's direct secret-counsel sense. It remains anchored to the same focus root and preserves secrecy's attempt at refuge, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical translation of نجوى here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نجوى at word 15, followed by the repeated collapse of numerical exceptions.

activation_trace.role: The direct branch supplies confidential speech as the actual lexical anchor.
Raised ground safe from flood supplies the exploratory material image of secrecy as a refuge above ordinary exposure.

changed_reading.before: Secret counsel is simply speech kept away from outsiders.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speakers treat privacy like high ground safe from an evidentiary flood, while the divine fourth or sixth removes that imagined refuge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the focus ayah's arithmetic onto the next passage's physical and social room-making. It remains anchored in the fourth and sixth ordinals and in 58:11's explicit opening of assembly space, but downstream prose should label it a sequence-based spatial activation, not claim that the ordinals lexically mean inclusive seating.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'هو رابعهم' and 'هو سادسهم' as repeated additions to apparently closed human groups.

activation_trace.role: Becoming fourth reopens the first closed count and supplies the arithmetic side of the spatial analogy.
Becoming sixth repeats the addition and prevents the image from depending on one group size.
Opening width and usable room translates count-reopening into an exploratory ethic of non-closed assemblies.
Rising and leaving a place adds bodily rearrangement to the assembly-space mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fourth and sixth are only arithmetic proofs of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: As a sequence-based activation, the unseen addition destabilizes closed social geometry and primes the command to make room and yield place in assemblies.

strongest_changes: 58:1 turns total knowledge into heard, dialogical attention to a lone complaint.
58:6 turns later informing into counter-memory: deeds are gathered, exhaustively counted, and witnessed even when actors forget.
58:8-10 makes accompaniment double-edged: it exposes hostile speakers and limits counsel's power to isolate its targets.
58:19 and 58:22 separate universal exposure from special affiliation, heart-inscription, and support.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's arithmetic did more than illustrate omniscience: it repeatedly reopened human circles, while the surrounding sequence supplied auditory, mnemonic, affective, economic, evidentiary, spatial, and affiliative mechanisms for what that openness does.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-isolation reading of 58:10 extends accompaniment toward the targets of counsel, whereas the immediate grammar of 'معهم' can remain confined to the speakers.
Advance charity may primarily test obedience rather than regulate privileged access, even though cost and purification support the access reading.
The high-ground refuge and assembly-space readings are deliberately contained material or sequence analogies, not direct lexical senses.
